questions.text: A cylindrical jar has radius 4 cm and height 15 cm. A label covers only the curved surface of the jar (not the top or bottom). Find the total area of labels needed for 6 identical jars.
questions.markingGuide:
Step 1: Area of one label = circumference × height = 2π × 4 × 15 = 120π = 376.99 cm².

Step 2: Total area of 6 labels = 6 × 376.99 = 2261.95 cm².

Step 3: Accept exact answer 720π cm².

Step 4: Achieved = correct area of one label, OR total area with a minor error.

Step 5: Merit = correct total area of all 6 labels with clear working.

Final answer: 2261.95 cm² (or 720π cm²).

questions.text: The 6 jars are packed into a rectangular box, arranged 3 wide × 2 long × 1 high. Each jar has radius r cm and height 15 cm. The volume of one jar is 15πr². The volume of the box is 360r². Find the proportion of space inside the box that is empty, and show that it is independent of the radius r.
questions.markingGuide:
Step 1: Volume of 6 jars = 6 × 15πr² = 90πr².

Step 2: Volume of empty space = 360r² – 90πr² = 90r²(4 – π).

Step 3: Proportion of empty space = 90r²(4 – π) / 360r² = (4 – π) / 4.

Step 4: The r² terms cancel, so the proportion is independent of the radius r.

Step 5: Achieved = correctly states volume of 6 jars = 90πr² OR volume of box = 360r².

Step 6: Merit = correct expression for empty space volume.

Step 7: Excellence = correct proportion (4 – π) / 4 with full working, clearly showing r² cancels.

questions.text:
Town P is 90 km due East of town M. Town N is 120 km due North of town M. There is a right angle at M.

Find the distance from P to N.
questions.markingGuide:
Step 1: Triangle MPN has a right angle at M.

Step 2: Using Pythagoras: PN² = MP² + MN² = 90² + 120² = 8100 + 14400 = 22500.

Step 3: PN = √22500 = 150 km.

Step 4: Award Achieved for correct distance with working shown.

questions.text: Find the bearing of town N from town P.
questions.expectedAnswer: Bearing of N from P is approximately 323° (accept 323.13° with rounding)
questions.markingGuide:
Step 1: Find angle MPN: tan(MPN) = MN/MP = 120/90 = 4/3.

Step 2: Angle MPN = arctan(4/3) = 53.13°.

Step 3: P is due east of M, so from P, M is due west (bearing 270°).

Step 4: N is due north of M, so from P, line PN is the line PM rotated 53.13° towards the north.

Step 5: Bearing of N from P = 270° + 53.13° = 323.13°.

Step 6: Achieved = correct angle MPN with working.

Step 7: Merit = correct bearing of N from P with clear trigonometric working.

Final answer: Bearing of N from P is approximately 323° (accept 323.13° with rounding).

questions.text: Car A travels from M to P at speed v km/h. Car B travels from M to N. The total travel time for both cars combined is 6 hours. Distance MP = 90 km, distance MN = 120 km. Find an expression for the speed of car B in terms of v.
questions.markingGuide:
Step 1: Time = Distance / Speed.

Step 2: Time for car A = 90/v hours.

Step 3: Time for car B = 120/S_B hours.

Step 4: Total: 90/v + 120/S_B = 6.

Step 5: Rearrange for S_B: 120/S_B = 6 – 90/v = (6v – 90)/v.

Step 6: Therefore S_B = 120v/(6v – 90).

Step 7: Achieved = correct expression for time of car A (= 90/v).

Step 8: Merit = correctly forming the equation 90/v + 120/S_B = 6.

Step 9: Excellence = correct expression S_B = 120v/(6v – 90) with full algebraic working.

Final answer: Speed of B = 120v / (6v – 90).

questions.text: A regular hexagon ABCDEF has side length 80 cm. O is the centre of the hexagon. Show that the angle OAB (where B is the next vertex along from A) equals 60°.
questions.markingGuide:
Step 1: The interior angle of a regular hexagon = (6 − 2) × 180° / 6 = 720° / 6 = 120°.

Step 2: By symmetry, the line OA from the centre O to vertex A bisects the interior angle at A.

Step 3: Therefore angle OAB = 120° / 2 = 60°.

Step 4: Award Achieved for clear working showing how 60° is obtained.

Final answer: Angle OAB = 60°.

questions.text: In a regular hexagon with side length 80 cm, the distance from the centre O to each vertex equals the side length, so OA = 80 cm. Let X be the midpoint of side AB, so OX is perpendicular to AB. In right-angled triangle OAX, OA = 80 cm and angle OAX = 60°. Find the lengths OX (the apothem) and AX.
questions.markingGuide:
Step 1: Using right-angled triangle OAX with hypotenuse OA = 80 cm and angle OAX = 60°.

Step 2: OX (opposite): sin 60° = OX/80, so OX = 80 × sin 60° = 80 × 0.8660 = 69.28 cm.

Step 3: AX (adjacent): cos 60° = AX/80, so AX = 80 × cos 60° = 80 × 0.5 = 40 cm.

Step 4: Achieved = one correct length.

Step 5: Merit = both lengths correct with clear trigonometric working.

Final answer: OX = 69.28 cm, AX = 40 cm.
